context.requirement_text: REQ-204: SSRF validation for webhook target_url. Adds Letflow.Webhooks.UrlValidator module that validates URLs at create/2 (fast rejection) and dispatch_http/3 (DNS rebinding defense). Adds INV-9 to security-invariants.md.

task.description: Security review of REQ-204 implementation. This is the SSRF-prevention requirement itself. Assess: (1) INV-1 applicability (UrlValidator introduces no new data-access path, only validation -- but confirm); (2) INV-4: validate no plaintext secrets are logged or leaked through the new validation path; (3) INV-7: no SQL in the new code; (4) INV-8: error handling in the new validation path uses typed results throughout; (5) the new INV-9 text in security-invariants.md is correctly stated and covers the full scope. Also confirm the implementation actually implements the protection it claims -- check blocked_ipv4?/1, blocked_ipv6?/1, scheme check, and DNS-resolution path.
acceptance_criteria: INV-1 applicability assessed (no new tenant data access path)
INV-4: no secret leakage in new code paths
INV-8: all error paths use {:ok,_}/{:error,_} typed results
INV-9: text is correctly stated and verifiable
blocked_ipv4?/1 covers all 5 required IPv4 ranges
blocked_ipv6?/1 covers ::1/128, fc00::/7, and IPv4-mapped forms
DNS failure correctly treated as blocked
